description: This file defines the Budget class and related functions for managing budgets, including validation, duplicate checks, and expense comparison within the ERPNext accounting module.

classes.name: BudgetError
classes.description: Custom validation error for budget-related issues.

classes.name: DuplicateBudgetError
classes.description: Validation error for duplicate budget entries.

classes.name: Budget
classes.description: Main class representing a Budget document with methods for autonaming, validation, and setting null values.

methods.name: autoname
methods.description: Generates a unique name for the Budget based on related fields.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the Budget instance.

methods.name: validate_duplicate
methods.description: Checks for existing duplicate budgets in the database.

methods.name: validate_accounts
methods.description: Validates that accounts assigned to the budget are valid and unique.

methods.name: set_null_value
methods.description: Sets project or cost_center to None based on budget_against type.

methods.name: validate_applicable_for
methods.description: Validates the applicability flags for the budget.
